name: software.distribute/distribute-software
title: Distribute Software
description: Daily tech news and AI lab releases: search stories, today's briefing, companies and labs.

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search the archive of technology stories and AI lab releases by keyword or topic. Returns matching stories with their original URL, date, source, the companies they are about, and a siteUrl on distribute.software.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. 'GPT-6 launch' or 'EU AI Act'.

since.description: Only stories on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

company.description: Only stories about this company: a slug from list_companies.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question about recent technology news, e.g. 'What did Apple announce this week?'. Returns a short answer written from the site's stories, with the stories it cites. Slower than search_stories; use search_stories for plain lookups.
